description: This file contains functions for parsing flow rules, configuring and managing flow offloads, and setting up traffic control (TC) classes specifically for Realtek RTL83xx switch drivers within the Linux kernel networking subsystem.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_parse_flow_rule(struct rtl838x_switch_priv * priv,struct flow_rule * rule,struct rtl83xx_flow * flow)
methods.description: Parses and extracts flow rule parameters from a flow rule object, populating the rtl83xx_flow structure.

methods.name: void rtl83xx_flow_bypass_all(struct rtl83xx_flow * flow)
methods.description: Sets the flow rule to bypass all processing paths, effectively disabling specific match conditions.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_parse_fwd(struct rtl838x_switch_priv * priv,const struct flow_action_entry * act,struct rtl83xx_flow * flow)
methods.description: Interprets flow action entries for forwarding actions and assigns appropriate port-based forwarding rules.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_add_flow(struct rtl838x_switch_priv * priv,struct flow_cls_offload * f,struct rtl83xx_flow * flow)
methods.description: Creates and adds a new flow rule to the switch's internal hash table and registers it with the underlying hardware.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_configure_flower(struct rtl838x_switch_priv * priv,struct flow_cls_offload * f)
methods.description: Configures a new flow classifier rule combining parsing, hash table insertion, and hardware rule addition.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_delete_flower(struct rtl838x_switch_priv * priv,struct flow_cls_offload * cls_flower)
methods.description: Removes a flow classifier rule from the hash table and deletes it from hardware processing.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_stats_flower(struct rtl838x_switch_priv * priv,struct flow_cls_offload * cls_flower)
methods.description: Retrieves and updates traffic statistics for a flow classifier rule.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_setup_tc_cls_flower(struct rtl838x_switch_priv * priv,struct flow_cls_offload * cls_flower)
methods.description: Sets up, deletes, or queries statistics of flow classifier rules based on command.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_setup_tc_block_cb(enum tc_setup_type type,void * type_data,void * cb_priv)
methods.description: Callback for setting up traffic control blocks, specifically for clsflower classifiers.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_setup_tc(struct net_device * dev,enum tc_setup_type type,void * type_data)
methods.description: Main entry point for setting up traffic control (tc) offload rules on the device, coordinating hash table initialization and callback registration.

ctags.signature: (struct rtl838x_switch_priv * priv,struct flow_cls_offload * f,struct rtl83xx_flow * flow)

ctags.name: rtl83xx_parse_flow_rule
ctags.signature: (struct rtl838x_switch_priv * priv,struct flow_rule * rule,struct rtl83xx_flow * flow)

ctags.name: rtl83xx_parse_fwd
ctags.signature: (struct rtl838x_switch_priv * priv,const struct flow_action_entry * act,struct rtl83xx_flow * flow)
